packageRules.description: Repo exception: Ionic majors arrive as one PR, so @ionic/react and @ionic/react-router move together.

Repo exception: router majors are never offered. @ionic/react-router's peer range sets the router major (9 needs react-router >=6.4 <7), and Renovate can't read it, so it would offer the latest router whatever Ionic supports (#223). When an Ionic major needs a new router, its PR fails install on the strict peer check, and the router moves in that PR.
Repo exception: graphql-request 7 (used by pga-tour-api) only supports graphql 14-16. Drop this once graphql-request supports 17.
Repo exception: @react-native/metro-config is pinned to the react-native version, because react-native-worklets' peer would otherwise pull the latest. It moves with an SDK upgrade, like react-native.
